patterns.title: PowerShell command not found
regex: The term '(?P<detail>[^']+)' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet
patterns.summary: The script called '{detail}', which does not exist in this session (missing module, typo, or a tool not on PATH for SYSTEM).

remediation.action: Check the module or tool is present
remediation.detail: Install the module, or call the executable by full path.
PATH and modules differ between your user and SYSTEM; test with PsExec -s.

patterns.title: Path not found
regex: Cannot find path '(?P<detail>[^']+)' because it does not exist
Could not find (?:a part of the path|file) '(?P<detail>[^']+)'
patterns.summary: The script looked for '{detail}' and it was not there.

remediation.action: Check the path exists in the install context
remediation.detail: Mapped drives and user-profile paths do not exist for SYSTEM.

patterns.title: PowerShell execution policy blocked the script
regex: running scripts is disabled on this system
patterns.summary: A PowerShell execution policy (usually set by GPO or Intune) blocked the script.

patterns.title: PowerShell syntax error
regex: The string is missing the terminator
patterns.summary: The script has a syntax error and never ran.

remediation.detail: Smart quotes and wrong file encoding are the usual culprits after copy/paste.

patterns.title: PowerShell module not found
regex: The specified module '(?P<detail>[^']+)' was not loaded because no valid module file was found
patterns.summary: The module '{detail}' is not installed for the account running the script.

remediation.action: Install the module for all users
remediation.detail: Use Install-Module -Scope AllUsers, or ship the module with the package.

patterns.title: PowerShell Constrained Language Mode
regex: Cannot invoke method\. Method invocation is supported only on core types in this language mode
patterns.summary: The script ran in Constrained Language Mode (usually from WDAC or AppLocker), which blocks many .NET calls.

remediation.action: Sign the script or allow it in the policy
remediation.detail: Unsigned scripts run constrained when script enforcement is on.
Use cmdlets instead of direct .NET method calls.
Look at the lines around it for the target object and message.
